profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hello 👋🏾 My name is Tiffany and I enjoy creating web sites and applications that engage and provide useful information to the end user.
I create features and fix bugs in the PHP framework Laravel and SQL. 

I am passionate about diversity in tech and spreading the word to women and kids about the tech industry. 

Find me here: https://linktr.ee/tthompson899
E-mail: Tdthompson899@gmail.com - Job inquiries

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Support production application built on .NET, Node.js, and Vue.js across a
microservices architecture
• Diagnose and resolve escalated issues involving third-party API integrations
and service communication failures
• Triage user-reported bugs across distributed services, reducing
time-to-resolutionon critical issues
• Leverage AI-powered development tools, including Cursor and OpenAI Codex, to
troubleshoot technical issues, evaluate implementation approaches, identify potential
code defects, and develop automated tests.

positions.title: Senior PHP Developer
positions.description:
Engineered web application utilizing PHP, Laravel, Slim and MySQL
Pair program and collaborate with team members to provide solutions to business problems
Troubleshoot critical and escalated bugs
Write technical notes for features
Create and update internal documentation related to our application
positions.insights: Skills: Laravel · REST APIs · PhpStorm · PHPUnit · Testing · MySQL · PHP · Test Automation

positions.title: Director of Digital Media
positions.description:
Take photos at events to upload to our Meetup page
Record speaker's talks, edit and upload videos to our Youtube channel

positions.title: Software Engineer, Back End Applications
positions.description:
Integrate application with Salesforce - Syncing data to and from our application to Salesforce
Create updates and features to admin and backend of consumer facing site using PHP, Laravel and MySQL
Communicate progress and delays of features and improvements with internal employees

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked on the front and back end of Active Building, a resident management portal
Used HTML, SASS, Javascript, JQuery and PHP
Completed a little over 50 issues and bugs

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Develop back end application using Laravel, PHP and SQL
Work with engineering team to create features to application

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
1. Push code to production on a weekly basis using Coldfusion, Javascript and JQuery
2. Within two weeks of hire, started contributing and pushing code to production
3. With help creating a layout of the page , coded a management/organization tool in 2 months time for the company's corporate intranet
4. Create basic CRUD queries using SQL
5. Regularly provide updates to the corporate intranet

positions.title: TA at SMU Coding Bootcamp with Trilogy Education Services
positions.description:
1. Ensure the instructor is keeping on track of the lesson plan for the day
2. Grade and Review student's code and give feedback 
3. Code one on with students and answer questions

positions.title: TA at SMU Coding Bootcamp with Trilogy
positions.description:
1. Ensure the instructor is keeping on track of the lesson plan for the day
2. Grade and Review student's code and give feedback 
3. Code one on with students and answer questions

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
Taught about 15 3rd graders to code Monday - Thursday for an hour
Taught up to 4 high schoolers to code (ages varied) in HTML and CSS
Worked alongside coworker through CodeSlams - 2 hr long coding sessions with middle schoolers
Completed reports daily after class and planned for class each day
Assist and monitor milestone projects, curriculum delivery, daily coding assignments, lesson plan tracking and provide support and additional training (as needed).

positions.title: Business Systems Analyst I
positions.description:
Resolve incoming support calls related to systems company utilizes
Evaluate systems functionality and assess user needs and operational impact
Provide technical support to internal and external customers
Consult with internal and external users to identify issues and clarify program and/or system intentions
Responsible for troubleshooting errors and workflow concerns related specifically to existing and future system applications
Create and Update email templates for new web based systems

positions.title: Data Integrity Analyst
positions.description:
Review and audit reports from mainframe and server processes to ensure data integrity.
Help co-workers with end of month costing of jobs
Research on mainframe to find missing information on applications
Monitor the processing status of jobs and contact management as needed if problems occur
Fill in the missing/correct source codes for various paper applications.
Successfully trained new co worker while continuing my daily duties

positions.title: Database Administrator
positions.description:
Data Entry for database
Prepare and sort documents to interpret data to be entered
Compile, sort and verify accuracy of data to be entered
Work with co workers overseas to find correct information to be entered into database

positions.title: Student Ambassador
positions.description:
Gave informative campus tours to prospective students
Worked with Admissions Office to stuff envelopes & help at Recruitment Events

volunteerExperiences.description: We help teach middle school aged kids to learn to code. These are kids that excited about code, many have already been coding, we want to keep them excited about programming and help them create things.
